title: The Complexity of Resilience for Digraph Queries
summary: We prove a complexity dichotomy for the resilience problem for unions of conjunctive digraph queries (i.e., for existential positive sentences over the signature $\{R\}$ of directed graphs). Specifically, for every union $μ$ of conjunctive digraph queries, the following problem is in P or NP-complete: given a directed multigraph $G$ and a natural number $u$, can we remove $u$ edges from $G$ so that $G \models \neg μ$?
